claim.claim-text: 2. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein a length of the first time period is greater than a length of the second time period.
3. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the first target temperature is higher than the second target temperature.
4. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the sum of the first time period and the second time period is greater than four minutes and less than five minutes.
5. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the sum of the first time period and the second time period is greater than three minutes and less than four minutes.
6. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, a proportion of the length of the first time period to the length of the second time period is a constant value.
7. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the heater is an induction heating type heater including an electrically conductive coil.
8. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the controller warm up the heater to reach the temperature of the heater to the first target temperature.

9. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the controller controls the temperature of the heater so that the amount of migration of nicotine increases in the first period and the amount of migration of nicotine decreases in the second period after the first period.

10. The aerosol generating device of claim 1, wherein the controller controls the temperature of the heater so that the amount of migration of glycerin increases in the first period and the amount of migration of glycerin decreases in the second period after the first period.
